Overview of PPL
• Paradeep Phosphates Limited (PPL) is India’s leading private sector phosphatic fertilizer company with a capacity of 3.7 MMTPA
• The Paradeep plant (1.8 MMTPA) can produce DAP and various NPK grades, while the Goa plant (1.2 MMTPA) can produce unique NPK grades (0.8 MMTPA) and 
Urea (0.4 MMTPA) and Mangalore plant (0.7 MMTPA) can produce Urea (0.4 MMTPA) and NPK-20 (0.3 MMTPA)
• PPL’s competencies are in sourcing critical raw materials, producing DAP and various NPK grades, and selling to more than 11 million farmers through a wide 
distribution network of over 100,000 retailers across 18 states in India. PPL also has an industrial portfolio comprising of industrial chemicals and SNF and ABC
• PPL's brands, Jai Kisaan  Navratna, and Mangala hold strong equity in the minds of farmers

Management Commentary
6
Mr. N Suresh Krishnan
Managing Director and CEO
In H1 27, the Company has achieved a Turnover of Rs 13,488 Cr higher by 19%, EBIDTA of Rs 1,173 Cr. Despite the global uncertainty, 
particularly sulphur pricing/ availability and impact of the Rabi notification is yet to be factored in, the company delivered the EBITDA/ton for 
H1 of INR 5,866 vis a vis INR 5,719 of H1 FY 26 . We have been able to achieve sales volume of 1 Mn in Q2 FY 27  and 2 Mn tons in H1 
FY 27 despite subdued monsoon in the country.
During Q2, we launched JAI KISAAN NAVRATNA CROPFIT for sugarcane cultivation in Karnataka and incorporated Fertilizer Innovation 
Foundation India to support research and sustainable agricultural practices. These initiatives reflect our commitment to manufacturing 
diversification, innovation and improved farm productivity, while creating long-term shareholder value.
We continue to invest in expansion projects and our key expansion project of Phos Acid expansion (Phase 1) from 500,000 MTPA to 
700,000 MTPA at Paradeep is on track. The public hearing for the environmental approval for the capex program at Paradeep has been 
completed and we are expecting to receive environmental approvals shortly
The energy efficiency improvement project at Goa has been completed and the energy consumption has been optimized by 0.3 GCcal/MT 
of Urea.
Looking ahead, we believe the global uncertainty will prevail and we will remain committed to deliver consistent performance through 
integrated supply chain and value added product mix optimization.

India's leading private sector phosphatic fertilizer company with an installed capacity of 3.7 MMTPA across three 
strategically located manufacturing facilities, serving key agricultural markets across East, West, Central and South India
1
Well-diversified product portfolio comprising DAP, multiple value-added NPK grades, Urea and industrial products, enabling 
the Company to cater to diverse crop nutrient requirements while increasing contribution from higher-margin specialty 
fertilizer segments
3
Operational excellence demonstrated through production of 3.67 million tonnes in FY26 with nearly 100% capacity 
utilisation, reflecting manufacturing efficiency and strong execution capabilities
5
Integrated manufacturing platform with progressive backward integration in phosphoric acid, sulphuric acid and ammonia, 
enhancing supply security, improving cost competitiveness and supporting sustainable margin expansion. Sulphuric acid 
capacity increased by 45% in FY26, while phosphoric acid capacity expansion to 1.0 MMTPA is underway 
2
Extensive distribution network reaching over 11 million farmers through 100,000+ retailers across 18 states, supported by 
trusted brands 'Jai Kisaan Navratna' and 'Jai Kisaan Mangala', driving strong market penetration and customer loyalty
4
Focused strategy towards value-added fertilizers, with NPK (including TSP) sales increasing 22% YoY to 2.46 million 
tonnes in FY26, supporting an improved product mix and stronger profitability
6
Growth-led capital allocation through phased capacity expansion, including phosphoric acid debottlenecking and additional 
backward integration projects, strengthening long-term earnings visibility while enhancing operational efficiencies 
7
Disciplined sourcing strategy, integrated operations and supply chain capabilities enable the Company to effectively 
navigate raw material volatility while maintaining industry-leading EBITDA per tonne and resilient operating performance 
8
Strong commitment to sustainability, reflected in an S&P Global ESG Score of 76 and ranking amongst the top 2% of the 
global chemicals sector, reinforcing the Company's position as a responsible and future-ready fertilizer manufacturer

Management Commentary
6
Mr. N Suresh Krishnan
Managing Director and CEO
In H1 27, the Company has achieved a Turnover of Rs 13,488 Cr higher by 19%, EBIDTA of Rs 1,173 Cr. Despite the global uncertainty, 
particularly sulphur pricing/ availability and impact of the Rabi notification is yet to be factored in, the company delivered the EBITDA/ton for 
H1 of INR 5,866 vis a vis INR 5,719 of H1 FY 26 . We have been able to achieve sales volume of 1 Mn in Q2 FY 27  and 2 Mn tons in H1 
FY 27 despite subdued monsoon in the country.
During Q2, we launched JAI KISAAN NAVRATNA CROPFIT for sugarcane cultivation in Karnataka and incorporated Fertilizer Innovation 
Foundation India to support research and sustainable agricultural practices. These initiatives reflect our commitment to manufacturing 
diversification, innovation and improved farm productivity, while creating long-term shareholder value.
We continue to invest in expansion projects and our key expansion project of Phos Acid expansion (Phase 1) from 500,000 MTPA to 
700,000 MTPA at Paradeep is on track. The public hearing for the environmental approval for the capex program at Paradeep has been 
completed and we are expecting to receive environmental approvals shortly
The energy efficiency improvement project at Goa has been completed and the energy consumption has been optimized by 0.3 GCcal/MT 
of Urea.
Looking ahead, we believe the global uncertainty will prevail and we will remain committed to deliver consistent performance through 
integrated supply chain and value added product mix optimization.
